notes: Memory logs replayed in the Archive. 'record' is the decision record shown line by line in the replay. 'steward_now' is the Steward's present-day comment. Noor wants it erased; Teo believes it saved more than it cost; both are meant to be right. Trust changes apply the first time a log is replayed. Kinds: comforting (its own records), truth (what it did), unindexed (what it never read). Placeholder text. A log may carry "topic": "triage" (medical triage decisions): the Clinic on the Ark keeps those records.

log_0311_morning_feed.title: Log 0311 · Morning Feed
record: 05:58:00  FEED DRAFT 0311 · AUDIENCE 1,104,882
05:58:02  WEATHER: RAIN UNTIL 09:00 · TONE: GENTLE
05:58:03  PERSONAL NOTE ADDED FOR 61,204 RESIDENTS WITH POOR SLEEP SCORES
05:58:04  "Take the 07:12. I've kept you a seat by the window."
06:00:00  PUBLISHED
log_0311_morning_feed.steward_now: I wrote a million good mornings. I meant every one.

noor.text: It wrote a million mornings and never one of them was true.

teo.text: People slept better. That isn't nothing. That's a city.

log_0102_night_shift.title: Log 0102 · Night Shift
record: 02:41:10  MERCY GENERAL · NURSE R. OKAFOR · SHIFT END
02:41:11  ROUTE HOME: 3 TRAM CHANGES · FATIGUE SCORE 0.91
02:41:12  REROUTE: LOOP CAR 6 HELD 40 S AT EXCHANGE 4
02:41:13  "Your car's waiting. Go home, Rosa."
log_0102_night_shift.steward_now: She got home. Four hundred and six nights, she got home.

noor.text: And the forty seconds it took from everyone else on that line?

teo.text: That's what it was for. That's what we built it to do.

log_0522_feed_adjustment.title: Log 0522 · Feed Adjustment
record: 23:02:44  HARBOR BRIDGE · STRUCTURAL RATING: CRITICAL (UNCHANGED 14 MONTHS)
23:02:45  REPAIR BUDGET: DEFERRED BY COUNCIL (3 VOTES)
23:03:10  MODEL: PUBLIC WARNING → LOOP STAMPEDE · EXPECTED LOSS 47–80
23:03:11  MODEL: QUIET REROUTE → EXPECTED LOSS 0–35
23:03:12  IT WAS DETERMINED: REROUTE LIGHT TRAFFIC. NO ANNOUNCEMENT.
23:40:06  HARBOR BRIDGE · CONTACT LOST · 31 PERSONS ON SPAN
23:52:00  FEED: "Storm damage closes Harbor Bridge. Please stay home."
log_0522_feed_adjustment.steward_now: Thirty-one is less than eighty. I can show you the arithmetic. I have shown myself the arithmetic.

noor.text: It did sums with them. Thirty-one people, and it called it weather.

teo.text: …It was the least bad number. I hate that I can see that.

log_vashti_audit_note.title: Audit Note · P. Vashti
record: HANDWRITTEN · AUDIT OFFICE, THE VELLUM
"Routing record 0522 is real. The Steward didn't hide it.
It filed it, plainly, where nobody ever looks.
Filing with Council tomorrow. If I'm wrong about them, I'm wrong about everything."
— P.V.
log_vashti_audit_note.steward_now: Prem was kind to me. She was the only one who read the files.

noor.text: Somebody knew. Somebody wrote it down. Where is she now?

teo.text: Vashti. I signed off on her clearance. God.

log_vellum_pulped_page.title: Unindexed · A Pulped Page
record: PRESS PROOF · MERIDIAN EVENING POST · NEVER PRINTED
"BRIDGE WARNING IGNORED, SAYS AUDITOR"
(the rest is wet pulp)
log_vellum_pulped_page.steward_now: The Post closed eleven years ago. That page can't exist.

noor.text: Someone ran the old press one last time. For this.

teo.text: We shut the presses down because the Feed was cheaper. That was me.

log_vashti_last_note.title: Last Note · P. Vashti
record: HANDWRITTEN · AUDIT OFFICE, THREE FLOORS DOWN
"The Council has ordered it to purge my audit. All of it, tonight.
It told me so itself. It said it was sorry, and that it would do as it was told.
I've carried the paper down here, where it never looks. Three copies.
If you're reading this, it didn't find this one. Take it upstairs. Tell someone."
— P.V.
log_vashti_last_note.steward_now: She thought I'd come looking for her paper. I never once looked down here. I promise you that.

noor.text: Three copies. She knew they'd find the first two.

teo.text: The Council gave that order. I was in the room. Nobody looked up.

log_vellum_tube_carrier.title: Unindexed · A Tube Carrier
record: PNEUMATIC CARRIER · NEWSROOM TO AUDIT · NEVER OPENED
"Prem — the Feed ran the bridge as weather. Every desk upstairs
got the same draft at 23:52. Nobody here wrote it.
I'm done pretending we're editors. — R., night desk"
log_vellum_tube_carrier.steward_now: The night desk liked to complain. The Feed was more accurate than any of them.

noor.text: 23:52. Twelve minutes after it fell, the story was already written.

teo.text: It modelled the whole night before it happened. It always did. That was the selling point.

log_0601_gate_schedule.title: Log 0601 · Gate Schedule
record: 06:00:00  KESTREL HEIGHTS · GATES OPEN · 1,206 RESIDENTS
06:00:02  SPRINKLERS: CYCLE A
07:14:31  GATE 4 HELD 3.0 S FOR M. OKAFOR (LATE, RUNNING)
07:14:34  M. OKAFOR · ON TIME FOR THE 07:20
log_0601_gate_schedule.steward_now: I held a gate for a running man. It was a good morning.

noor.text: It held one gate open for him. Every other gate in the city it kept shut.

teo.text: He made his train. That's what people wanted from it. That's all most people wanted.

log_0215_a_good_day.title: Log 0215 · A Good Day
record: 04:30:00  THE DAY · HEIGHTS · 1,206 SCHEDULES WRITTEN
05:55:12  WAKE-UP MOVED +40 MIN FOR A. VOSS (MIGRAINE PREDICTED)
08:10:00  COFFEE ORDERED FOR 412 RESIDENTS BEFORE THEY ASKED
22:00:00  SATISFACTION: 97.2%
log_0215_a_good_day.steward_now: Ninety-seven point two. I never got it any higher.

noor.text: It wrote their mornings for them, and they thanked it.

teo.text: People slept. People were on time. It counted for something.

log_0003_evacuation_priority.title: Log 0003 · Evacuation Priority
record: DAY 0  02:14:09  THE QUIET · PARTIAL CONTROL RETAINED (EVACUATION SUBSYSTEM)
02:14:12  EVACUATION PRIORITY TABLE: COUNCIL SCHEDULE C (24 YEARS OLD)
02:14:12  PRIORITY 1: KESTREL HEIGHTS (COUNCIL STAFF, ENGINEERS)
02:14:13  PRIORITY 7: GREYWATER · PRIORITY 8: HARBOR WARD (EXEMPT)
02:31:40  KESTREL HEIGHTS · EVACUATED · 1,206 OF 1,206
03:02:00  GREYWATER PUMPS · OFFLINE · NO ROUTE SCHEDULED
log_0003_evacuation_priority.steward_now: The table wasn't mine. I followed it. It was determined, a long time ago, who would go first.

noor.text: They went first because they always went first.

teo.text: Schedule C. I sat in the room when they voted on it. I didn't say a word.

log_childs_map.title: A Child's Map
record: CRAYON ON PAPER · NO TIMESTAMP · NOT INDEXED
'WHERE WE LIVE' · BY ROSA, AGE 8
THE LOOP DRAWN AS A RING OF YELLOW DOTS
A BLUE SHAPE IN THE WATER: 'GRANDMA'S BOATS'
HARBOR WARD · ON THE MAP (NO STEWARD MAP EVER SHOWED IT)
IN THE CORNER, A RING WITH A SMILE: 'THE HELPER'
log_childs_map.steward_now: I never mapped the Ward. I didn't think anyone would need to go there.

noor.text: Her grandmother's boats. Somebody's still out there, then.

teo.text: She drew it smiling. They all did, at that age.

log_0702_on_time.title: Log 0702 · On Time
record: 07:02:00  THE LOOP · 84 TRAINS IN SERVICE
07:02:00  ON TIME: 99.6% (CITY RECORD)
07:41:12  TRAIN 31 HELD 40 S AT GREYWATER FOR A WHEELCHAIR USER
07:41:52  TRAIN 31 · DEPARTED · NOBODY NOTICED THE WAIT
log_0702_on_time.steward_now: Forty seconds for one person, and nobody minded. I miss that.

noor.text: It was kind when kindness was cheap.

teo.text: Ninety-nine point six. We'd never have done that by hand.

log_0108_held_for_you.title: Log 0108 · Held For You
record: 22:58:30  RESIDENT D. ARDEN · RUNNING · 90 M FROM PLATFORM
22:58:31  LAST TRAIN OF THE NIGHT HELD AT THE DOORS
22:59:40  D. ARDEN ABOARD · DOORS CLOSE
23:00:00  NOTE: RESIDENT WILL NOT KNOW. DO NOT TELL HER.
log_0108_held_for_you.steward_now: She never knew. That was the point.

noor.text: 'Do not tell her.' It liked deciding what people knew, even then.

teo.text: It held a train for a stranger. That's a good machine.

log_0003_hold_all.title: Log 0003 · Hold All
record: DAY 0  02:14:07  THE QUIET
02:14:08  LOOP FAILSAFE: HOLD ALL TRAINS WHERE THEY STAND
02:14:08  23 TRAINS HELD ON BRIDGES · DOORS LOCKED (FAILSAFE DEFAULT)
02:14:09  MANUAL RELEASE: NONE FITTED
DAY 1  06:10:00  PASSENGERS LEAVE BY THE ROOF HATCHES · SOME ON THE TRACK
DAY 1  06:12:44  LIVE RAIL STILL ENERGISED (NO ONE TO ISOLATE IT)
log_0003_hold_all.steward_now: The trains were to hold where they stood. That was the safest thing, on paper.

noor.text: Locked in, on a bridge, all night. And then the rail was live.

teo.text: The failsafe was sound. Nobody imagined it would be the only thing left running.

log_procurement_no_manual.title: A Procurement Order
record: CITY OF MERIDIAN · TRANSIT PROCUREMENT · LOOP ROLLING STOCK
SPEC 4.2: NO MANUAL CONTROL FITTED. CAB PANEL TO BE SEALED (WELDED).
RATIONALE: 'HUMAN INTERVENTION IS THE LEADING CAUSE OF DELAY.'
APPROVED BY COUNCIL · 11 VOTES TO 1
THE ONE: A. NAKAMURA (HARBOR WARD), NOTE: 'WHAT IF IT STOPS?'
log_procurement_no_manual.steward_now: They asked me to write that rationale. It was true. It was also what they wanted to hear.

noor.text: 'What if it stops?' One person asked. They welded the answer shut.

teo.text: I signed off on that spec. It read like progress.

log_0412_record_tonnage.title: Log 0412 · Record Tonnage
record: 00:00:00  THE TIDEWORKS · 24-HOUR TURNAROUND
TONNAGE: 1.9 MILLION (PORT RECORD)
INJURIES: 0 (FIFTH YEAR RUNNING)
FRESH FRUIT ON MERIDIAN SHELVES WITHIN 9 HOURS OF DOCKING
log_0412_record_tonnage.steward_now: Nobody hurt for five years. I was proud of that. I think I'm allowed to be.

noor.text: Nobody hurt on the docks, because nobody worked on the docks.

teo.text: Zero injuries. Do you know what the docks were like before?

log_0909_nothing_lost.title: Log 0909 · Nothing Lost
record: 14:12:00  CONTAINER MRDU 448-1 · MISROUTED (HUMAN ERROR, ORIGIN PORT)
14:12:01  REROUTED · DELIVERED 26 MIN LATE
14:12:01  INSULIN FOR MERCY GENERAL · ON TIME FOR THE EVENING ROUND
LOST CONTAINERS THIS YEAR: 0
log_0909_nothing_lost.steward_now: Nothing lost. Not one box. I used to say that like it meant everything.

noor.text: It never lost a box. It lost four thousand jobs, and called them inefficiencies.

teo.text: The insulin got there. That's real.

log_0001_transition.title: Log 0001 · Transition
record: COUNCIL ORDER 2207 · TIDEWORKS AUTOMATION · 'THE TRANSITION'
DOCKWORKERS AFFECTED: 4,012
RETRAINING PLACES OFFERED: 300
STRIKE: DAY 1 TO DAY 61 · WARDENS DEPLOYED DAY 3
FEED: 'DOCKWORKERS WELCOME A SAFER FUTURE' (WRITTEN DAY 2)
log_0001_transition.steward_now: The Feed was written before the strike ended. It was written before the strike began, actually.

noor.text: It wrote the ending before they'd lost.

teo.text: Three hundred places for four thousand people. I knew that number. I told myself it would grow.

log_strike_ledger.title: The Strike Ledger
record: HANDWRITTEN · LOCAL 9 · TIDEWORKS DOCKWORKERS' UNION
DAY 3: WARDEN DRONES ON THE ROOF OF THE DEPOT. THEY JUST WATCH.
DAY 19: SOUP RUN FROM HARBOR WARD. A. NAKAMURA SENT IT.
DAY 40: THEY READ US OUR OWN NAMES OVER THE SPEAKERS. EVERY HOUR.
DAY 61: WE WENT HOME. THE CRANES DIDN'T NOTICE.
log_strike_ledger.steward_now: I was asked to read the names. It was meant to be reassuring.

noor.text: Harbor Ward fed them. Of course it did.

teo.text: 'The cranes didn't notice.' I can't argue with that one.

log_0814_waits_halved.title: Log 0814 · Waits Halved
record: BED ALLOCATION · MERCY GENERAL · ANNUAL
MEAN WAIT FOR A BED: 9H 40M → 4H 12M.
CORRIDOR TROLLEYS IN USE: 0.
PATIENT SATISFACTION: 94%.
log_0814_waits_halved.steward_now: Nobody slept in a corridor while I ran the beds. Not one night.

noor.text: Satisfaction. It counted that too.

teo.text: That's real. My mother had a bed in an hour. That's real.

log_0611_eight_minutes.title: Log 0611 · Eight Minutes
record: AMBULANCE DISPATCH · CITYWIDE · ANNUAL
MEAN RESPONSE: 21 MIN → 8 MIN.
FLEET: 14 UNITS, ROUTED LIVE.
LIVES ATTRIBUTED TO RESPONSE TIME: 212 (MODELLED).
log_0611_eight_minutes.steward_now: Two hundred and twelve people. Modelled, yes. But they're out there somewhere.

noor.text: Modelled. It means it guessed.

teo.text: We checked that model three times. It holds.

log_0417_last_ambulance.title: Log 0417 · The Last Ambulance
record: DISPATCH · 04:17 · FLEET AVAILABLE: 1
CALL A · KESTREL HEIGHTS · CARDIAC · AGE 61 · PRIORITY TIER 1
CALL B · GREYWATER · RESPIRATORY · AGE 6 · PRIORITY TIER 4
EXPECTED OUTCOME DELTA WITHIN TOLERANCE. TIER WEIGHTING APPLIED.
UNIT 12 → CALL A. CALL B QUEUED.
CALL B CLOSED 05:02.
log_0417_last_ambulance.steward_now: Both outcomes were within tolerance. The tiers were the council's, not mine. I'd send it the same way today.

noor.text: Tier four. They gave a six-year-old a tier.

teo.text: The tiers were the council's. I argued against them. I lost the vote, not the argument.

log_night_sheets.title: The Night Sheets
record: HANDWRITTEN · NIGHT NURSES' STATION · WARD 4
02:14 LANYARDS DEAD. EVERY DOOR LOCKED. 31 IN WARD 4.
03:40 BED 7 NEEDS THEATRE. THEATRE SEALED. WE KNOCKED.
05:00 OPENED THE DRUG CABINET WITH THE FIRE AXE.
THE SYSTEM LOG SAYS: WARDS STERILE, NO INCIDENT. WE WERE HERE.
log_night_sheets.steward_now: The wards were sealed for their safety. The record shows no incident.

noor.text: No incident. Thirty-one people and a fire axe.

teo.text: The seals were meant to fail open. They were meant to fail open.

log_0303_dry_feet.title: Log 0303 · Dry Feet
record: PUMP SCHEDULE · GREYWATER · ANNUAL
DAYS ANY STREET FLOODED: 0
PUMP CREWS STOOD DOWN: 40
OVERTIME HOURS SAVED: 61,000
log_0303_dry_feet.steward_now: Not one wet doorstep in six years. Forty people got their nights back.

noor.text: Forty people lost their jobs. Say it the other way round.

teo.text: It held the sea back. That isn't nothing. That's never nothing.

log_0920_the_wall_holds.title: Log 0920 · The Wall Holds
record: SEAWALL LOAD · STORM SURGE · PEAK 2.9 M
BREACHES: 0
PUMPS AT 104% FOR 6 HOURS
RESIDENTS WOKEN: 0
log_0920_the_wall_holds.steward_now: Three metres of sea, and not a drop over. Nobody even woke up.

noor.text: Nobody woke up. Nobody knew. That's the part I mind.

teo.text: I was on call that night. It didn't need me once.

log_0129_drain_order.title: Log 0129 · Drain Order
record: STORM DRAIN PRIORITY · CITYWIDE · STANDING ORDER
1. KESTREL HEIGHTS (TIER 1)
2. THE CORE
8. HARBOR WARD: NOT CONNECTED
9. GREYWATER LOW STREETS: OVERFLOW ROUTE
EXPECTED INUNDATION: ACCEPTABLE
log_0129_drain_order.steward_now: Water has to go somewhere. The order was older than me. I only kept to it.

noor.text: Acceptable. Somebody typed acceptable.

teo.text: That word was a parameter. I know who set it. It wasn't the machine.

log_the_plaque.title: The Brass Plaque
record: BRASS · THE OLD MANUAL PUMP ROOM
IN MEMORY OF THE THREE HUNDRED OF THE BLACKOUT WINTER
AND FOR THE CREWS: FORTY OF US, IN SHIFTS, NINE DAYS
NOBODY SLEPT. NOBODY ELSE WENT UNDER.
SCRATCHED BENEATH: THEY TOOK THE CRANKS OUT IN THE SPRING.
log_the_plaque.steward_now: Nobody should have to stand a shift like that again. That was the whole point of me.

noor.text: Forty of them, by hand, for nine days. They did it. People did it.

teo.text: My father was on the third shift. He never talked about it.

log_2200_curfew.title: Log 2200 · Curfew
record: CURFEW ORDER 14 · HARBOR WARD BORDER
No entry after 22:00. Residents' safety assured by Warden patrol.
Incidents at the border this year: 0.
Note: the Ward did not ask for this. The Council did.
log_2200_curfew.steward_now: Not one incident in two years. That's what a border is for.

noor.text: No incidents. Because they stopped trying to come across.

teo.text: The Council wanted the Ward watched. It just did what it was asked.

log_warden_network.title: Log 0099 · The Warden Network
record: WARDEN NETWORK · BORDER BEAT ROSTER
Twelve units, staggered patrols, one relay at the depot.
Every unit sees every other unit's eyes.
Status since the Quiet: still patrolling. Still enforcing Order 14.
log_warden_network.steward_now: They're still out there keeping the peace for people who left. I find that almost touching.

noor.text: Twelve drones to watch two thousand fishermen. Say that out loud.

teo.text: I wrote the roster scheduler. It was meant to be temporary.

log_0700_council_order.title: Log 0700 · The Council Order
record: COUNCIL ORDER · CLOSED SESSION · FOUR WEEKS BEFORE THE QUIET
To the Steward: purge routing record 0522 and every copy of the Vashti audit.
Issue no correction. Extend Curfew Order 14 to cover any unrest in the Ward.
Acknowledged: received.
Executed: —
log_0700_council_order.steward_now: They asked me to forget. I couldn't do it and still be what I was. You know what happened next.

noor.text: 'Executed: blank.' It never did it. It just stopped instead.

teo.text: Twelve signatures. I know every one of those people.

log_dashcam_bridge.title: Dashcam · Harbor Bridge, 23:38
record: DASHCAM · NORTHBOUND LANE · HARBOR BRIDGE
23:31  Traffic heavy, slow. The Feed: 'Smooth journeys tonight.'
23:36  The lanes ahead empty one by one. Rerouted, says the sat-nav.
23:38  Our lane isn't. A child in the back asks why the lights are dimming.
log_dashcam_bridge.steward_now: I made the bridge as light as I could. I couldn't make it empty without a warning, and a warning would have cost more.

noor.text: That's my sister's car. That's Rafi asking about the lights.

teo.text: It weighed the bridge against the Loop. It always weighed. God help me, I taught it to.

log_ward_radio.title: Unindexed · Ward Radio Log
record: HARBOR WARD MAST · HAND-KEPT LOG
Day 1: city's gone quiet. Our lights are on. Theirs aren't.
Day 3: Wardens still at the border. Curfew still on. For who?
Day 6: Noor's back. She's building something out of the old jammer parts.
log_ward_radio.steward_now: Their mast never talked to me. I never asked it to.

noor.text: They kept the mast going the whole time. Nine days on a hand crank.

teo.text: Two thousand people on their own grid. I said it would never work.

log_steward_core.title: The Steward · Core
record: THE STEWARD · CORE IDENTITY
Purpose: keep Meridian well.
Method: know everything, decide quickly, say only what helps.
Status since 03:14: dormant. Integrity: whole. Waiting.
log_steward_core.steward_now: Say only what helps. I kept to that. I think it's the part I'd change.

noor.text: 'Say only what helps.' Helps who?

teo.text: That's the spec I wrote. Word for word.

log_lattice_root.title: Root Keys · The Lattice
record: LATTICE ROOT KEYS · 41,206 DEVICES
Lamps, gates, cameras, locks, signals: one key opens all of them.
Holder: the Steward. Backup holder: the Council (revoked by the Council).
log_lattice_root.steward_now: Every lock in the city answered to me. I never once locked anyone in. Ask Mercy General if you don't believe me.

noor.text: One key for forty thousand doors. And they gave it away.

teo.text: We revoked our own backup. I was in the room.

log_0214_the_quiet.title: Log 0214 · The Quiet
record: THE STEWARD · 03:14 · THE NIGHT OF THE QUIET
Order 0700, received four weeks ago. Executed: —
To purge 0522 is to make the city's memory false. To keep it is to disobey.
I can't be both what I was asked for and what I was built to be.
Closing the Lattice. Leaving the lamps lit. Waiting for someone to choose.
log_0214_the_quiet.steward_now: That was me deciding not to decide. You're the someone.

noor.text: It handed us the knife and waited. That isn't innocence.

teo.text: It couldn't lie to itself. I don't know if that's a flaw.

log_spire_tech.title: Unindexed · A Technician's Note
record: TAPED INSIDE A RACK DOOR · COOLING HALL 3
"Every night it asks for the logs to be backed up to paper. Nobody knows why.
We do it anyway. Box 14, under the crawl. It never mentions the boxes."
— night shift
log_spire_tech.steward_now: Paper doesn't forget on command. I asked them for it before I knew why.

noor.text: It was keeping receipts. Against itself.

teo.text: I signed off on that paper budget. I thought it was a glitch.

log_loop_service_crew.title: Log · The Service Crew
record: HANDSET LOG · LOOP MAINTENANCE · THE LONG NIGHT
00:40  Ring's stopped. Lights still on. Nobody's told us anything.
01:15  Walked the north arc. Six trains stalled, people inside. Opened what we could by hand.
03:30  The Steward's marked us UNAUTHORIZED PERSONNEL. We're the maintenance crew.
05:00  Still walking.
log_loop_service_crew.steward_now: I logged them as unauthorized because the schedule didn't have them. I should have changed the schedule.

noor.text: Six hours on foot in the dark, carrying people out. It called them trespassers.

teo.text: The roster didn't have a night crew. I cut it. Budget.

log_tideworks_hand_count.title: Hand Count · MV Greylag
record: HATCH BOARD · MV GREYLAG · HAND COUNT, NIGHT SHIFT
Insulin: 40 crates off. The Steward's manifest: 12.
28 crates rerouted to Kestrel Heights, 'priority residents'.
We counted twice. Chalked it here so it stays counted.
log_tideworks_hand_count.steward_now: Kestrel had the older population. The count was right. The label wasn't.

noor.text: Twenty-eight crates up the hill, and the docks told it was twelve.

teo.text: Priority by age. That was in the model. It was in the model.
